source_definition: The source gives a simple graph. Its outputs are proper vertex colorings with at most three colors, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: The target gives a graph and k. Find at most k vertex classes and one closed interval per vertex so that adjacency holds exactly for intersecting intervals in different classes, or report NO-SOLUTION. Endpoint weak-order ranks give a finite encoding.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
